jobs.title: Civil Inspector - Stormwater
jobs.description: ​​​​​​​We are seeking a highly experienced Civil Inspector to support the supervision and inspection of stormwater drainage infrastructure works. The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring construction activities, ensuring compliance with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and authority requirements. The role includes inspection of pipelines, manholes, drainage structures, testing activities, reinstatement works, and coordination with contractors, surveyors, and project teams to ensure the successful delivery of stormwater projects. Inspect sewerage and stormwater drainage works in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and DM requirements. Verify setting out, alignment, coordinates, invert levels, slopes, and gradients of pipelines. Inspect excavation, trench preparation, shoring, dewatering, and formation levels. Check bedding material, thickness, compaction, and pipe foundation before pipe installation. Inspect installation of sewer and stormwater pipes, including joints, connections, and fittings. Verify pipe diameter, material, class/SDR, and approved manufacturer details. Inspect manholes, catch pits, gullies, chambers, headwalls, and other drainage structures. Check reinforcement, formwork, concrete grade, dimensions, and finishing of drainage structures. Verify manhole invert levels, benching, channels, covers, frames, and internal finishes. Inspect connections to existing sewerage and stormwater networks. Witness CCTV inspection, leakage testing, hydrostatic testing, air testing, and other required tests. Check pipeline pressure/leakage tests and ensure test results comply with project requirements. Inspect backfilling and ensure approved material is placed and compacted in required layers. Verify compaction test results for trenches and reinstatement works. Inspect road crossings, sleeves, protection works, and utility crossings. Coordinate with surveyors to verify line, level, and as-built information. Review and monitor Inspection Requests (IRs), checklists, and relevant inspection records. Identify defective/non-conforming works and report them to the Resident Engineer. Monitor rectification of defects and verify closure of NCRs and site observations. Coordinate with utilities, road works, electrical, mechanical, and other disciplines to avoid clashes. Monitor protection of existing sewerage and stormwater services during construction. Ensure temporary works, diversion arrangements, and bypass pumping are properly implemented where required. Inspect reinstatement of roads, footpaths, kerbs, and other affected areas after utility works. Maintain daily inspection reports, site records, photographs, and test documentation. Support final inspection, snagging, as-built verification, and handover of sewerage and stormwater works. Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline. Minimum 7-10 years of experience in construction supervision and inspection of stormwater, drainage, sewerage, and utility infrastructure projects. Proven experience in inspecting stormwater drainage networks, pipelines, manholes, catch pits, chambers, culverts, outfalls, and associated civil works . Strong knowledge of pipeline installation, trenching, bedding, backfilling, compaction, and reinstatement requirements. Experience witnessing and reviewing testing activities including CCTV inspections, leakage testing, hydrostatic testing, air testing, and compaction testing. Familiarity with Dubai Municipality (DM) standards, project specifications, and local authority requirements. Ability to verify line, level, coordinates, invert levels, gradients, and survey records. Experience reviewing Inspection Requests (IRs), quality records, test reports, method statements, and NCR close-outs. Strong understanding of construction materials, concrete works, reinforcement inspection, and drainage structures.

Records, Correspondence & Reporting Manage the project's incoming and outgoing correspondence, ensuring proper logging, distribution and timely response. jobs.title: Senior Planning Engineer

Assist in progress measurement and earned value analysis. Monitor engineering, procurement, and construction activities against approved schedules. Review contractor schedules and assess compliance with contractual requirements. Support scope control, change management, and schedule baseline maintenance. Coordinate with Resident Engineers, Project Managers, contractors, and stakeholders regarding project progress and planning issues. Minimum 5-10 years of experience in planning and scheduling infrastructure projects. Familiarity with Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling techniques. Strong understanding of construction drawings, specifications, and contract documentation. Knowledge of project controls, cost control, progress measurement, and reporting systems. Experience in schedule development, baseline preparation, and schedule updates. Understanding of scope management, change management, and earned value methodology. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and reporting skills in English.

Degree in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering or a related field, or demonstrated equivalent experience.

Coordinate with the Resident Engineer, Commercial Manager, Planning Engineer, and Site Engineers . Review subcontractor quantities, invoices, and payment submissions where applicable. Prepare cost reports, forecasts, and financial updates for management. Monitor project cash flow and expenditure against the approved budget. Maintain records of approved variations, instructions, and commercial correspondence. Support preparation of Final Account and project close-out documentation. Ensure measurements and commercial assessments comply with contract requirements and applicable standards . Assist in identifying commercial risks and cost-saving opportunities . Attend progress and commercial meetings and provide quantity/cost updates . Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline from a recognized university. Minimum 10 years of experience in quantity surveying, contract administration, and cost management for infrastructure, utilities, roads, and civil engineering projects. Ensure that all setting-out activities are carried out in accordance with approved method statements and calibration procedures. Conduct as-built surveys and verify the accuracy of contractors’ as-built drawings prior to submission. Monitor microtunneling drive alignments and breakthrough coordinates, ensuring compliance with allowable tolerances. Maintain up-to-date survey records, field books, and digital data files, ensuring full traceability of survey operations. Coordinate with the contractor and supervision team to resolve survey discrepancies or deviations on-site. Verify and certify survey results for measurement sheets, interim payments, and progress verification. Participate in pre-construction and progress meetings to provide input on survey status, site constraints, and required actions. Ensure full compliance with HSE standards during all field operations, particularly in confined-space and shaft areas. Calibrate and maintain survey instruments (total stations, GPS, digital levels) in accordance with project QA/QC procedures. Provide support during testing, commissioning, and handover stages by verifying final levels and coordinates. Proven experience in setting-out and as-built surveys for pipelines, shafts, tunnels, manholes, chambers, and associated civil works. Proficient in the use of Total Stations, GPS/GNSS equipment, Digital Levels, and related surveying software. Familiarity with Dubai Municipality requirements, local coordinate systems, and infrastructure construction practices. jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About The Team:

The Personalization team sits within Careem's Data Science organization and owns the AI systems that decide what every user sees, in what order, and why across Food, Quik, and Shops. Our mission is to build the hyper-personalization layer for the Careem app: real-time, cross-vertical recommendation and ranking systems that learn from a user's behavior in one vertical and apply that understanding everywhere else they engage with Careem. jobs.description: The Land Surveyor will be responsible for performing precise surveying and setting-out activities for stormwater and microtunneling works, including shafts, tunnels, pipelines, chambers, and related structures. About the role

We're looking for a Senior Operations Associate - Shops to own the performance of our Shops marketplace across the UAE and Jordan. This is a purely marketplace mandate so your world is Shops partners, their in-store picking teams, and the KPIs that determine a delightful customer experience. You'll sit at the intersection of Shops partners operations, strategic planning, and hands-on picking excellence.

What you'll do

  • Shops Partners Operations Performance. Own the end-to-end performance scorecard for Shops partners across UAE & JOR - order acceptance rate, prep time, order accuracy, cancellation rate, and customer contact rate and run the cadence that holds Shops accountable to it.
  • Strategic Planning & KPI Improvement. Translate performance gaps into a strategic roadmap: identify the top drivers of GMV leakage, AOV underperformance, and take-rate erosion, and build the initiatives that close them, from pilot to regional rollout.
  • Picking Operations Management. Manage the picking operation embedded within partner stores across UAE and Jordan - picker productivity, pick-to-pack time, and accuracy, including training standards, tooling, and process design that partners can actually run day-to-day.
  • Unit Economics. Build and defend the Last-Mile Unit Economics of every Shops partners cohort, working with Captain Operations to balance delivery cost, speed, and Captain earnings.
  • Business Reviews. Run quarterly and monthly business reviews with top Shops accounts, using cohort-level data (e.g., "Based on recent cohorts in Abu Dhabi and Amman...") to justify investment or intervention.
  • Peak Planning. Lead peak-season readiness planning for Ramadan and Dubai Shopping Festival - demand forecasting, Shops capacity planning, and picking-team surge staffing.
